name: Tokai Rika Co., Ltd.
summary: Tokai Rika Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive parts in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. The company offers human interface systems and controls, including shift levers; touchpads; multi-function, power window, steering, heater control, push start, hazard, fog lamp, power outer mirror, defogger, rheostat light control, and seat switches, as well as neutral start, engine oil pressure, parking brake, door lock, brake lamp, courtesy lamp, and buckup light sensing switches.
